calculation_handling.description: Applications submitted before July 22, 2022 and eligible under 200.25.15.1 to 200.25.15.4 must comply with the listed 970.10 parking regulations.
Applications submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 and eligible under 200.25.15.1 to 200.25.15.4 must comply with the listed 200.5 and 970.10 parking regulations.

200.25.15(1).explanation: An eligible application submitted before July 22, 2022 must meet the listed Chapter 970.10 parking space regulations.

200.25.15(2).explanation: An eligible application submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 must meet the listed Chapter 200.5 and 970.10 parking space regulations.
